comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 needs a comment that uses a first-hand (or personally known) real-world experience to contrast with the OP's view. It excludes hypotheticals, statistics and general facts. Feature 1 needs any comment with a clear, logically coherent counterargument or evidence bearing on the OP's claim, and it does not require personal experience. A well-reasoned counterargument need not be experiential, and a personal-experience contrast need not be well reasoned. The null rules also differ: feature 0 is null if OP context is missing, while feature 1 is null only if both title and argument are missing.
